functions.name: FIND-METHOD
functions.law: Returns the method matching the exact method qualifiers and parameter specializers in one generic function; this query is not the same operation as dispatch for runtime arguments.
functions.positive_witness: A generic function has integer and number methods plus a :before integer method; exact lookup returns the selected descriptor and differs by qualifier/specializer.
falsifiers: An absent signature with errorp=false must return NIL.
An absent signature with default errorp and an invalid specializer-list arity must signal an error.
The exact number-specialized method descriptor is not the method dispatched for an integer argument when an integer-specialized method exists.

functions.name: REMOVE-METHOD
functions.law: Removes one method object from a generic function, returns that same generic function, and does not signal an error if the specified method is not currently among that generic function's methods.
functions.positive_witness: Removing the integer-primary method leaves the number-primary and before methods, changes dispatch for 42 to the number method, and repeated removal of the now-absent method remains a no-error result.
falsifiers: The unrelated number or before method disappears.
The removed integer method remains discoverable or is still chosen for dispatch.

functions.name: CHANGE-CLASS
functions.law: Destructively changes an instance's class and returns the same instance; common local-slot values and common local-slot unbound state are preserved, and update-instance-for-different-class runs.
functions.positive_witness: An instance changes from the source class to the target class while preserving identity/value/unbound slot state; the new slot initializes, and the update hook observes the old value and current instance.
falsifiers: A fresh object is returned instead of the original instance.
A common unbound slot becomes bound or a common bound value is lost.
The target class is not visible after change-class.
The newly added slot is not initialized by its declared initform or the update hook does not run.
